name: Long-liquidation recovery
hypothesis: Buy after a verified liquidation burst subsides, spot price reclaims support, and funding/mark conditions normalize.
spec: Setup: Forced long closures may create a short-lived overshoot. Entry: Buy after a verified liquidation burst subsides, spot price reclaims support, and funding/mark conditions normalize. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit below the liquidation low or on renewed forced selling. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs open-interest, funding and liquidation history at intraday resolution (not connected)
